Name: Sit To Pass Time
Author: vapor64
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Time skip feature:[/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Sit on any furniture, or world map benches,swings,etc. to bring up a prompt which tells you to press a configured key to trigger time skip UI. The time skip UI can be set to any time of the day to skip to.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][u][b]Configurable values(GMCM required):[/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]TimeSkipKey- The key which brings up the time skip UI[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][u]Things to note:[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Skipping time to 2:00 AM will cause your character to pass out as they usually do in-game[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Please consider endorsing this mod if you find it helpful.[/size]

[size=4][b][u]Installation :[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Download latest mod file
e.g. "SitToPassTime.zip"[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Extract the contents of the mod file to your Stardew Valley mods folder
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\"[/i][/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][u]Compatibility :[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.1[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Not tested on Android yet[/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Source Code : [url=https://github.com/vapor-64/StardewModsSourceCode]Github
[/url]If this mods helps you, please consider donating on [url=https://ko-fi.com/vapor64]Ko-fi[/url][/size]

Manifest.Name: Sit To Pass Time
Manifest.Description: Allows the player to sit on furniture to pass time.
